entries.rationale: Authored switch oracle: legal a0 vs disabled a4; mask state pair; three increasing stages; local non-text regions and movement/progress probes. All core fixture decisions covered; fixture-only, never candidate approval.

Coverage review includes present/absent targets, shielding support, firing polarity, focus, enemy/recruited and core lock; aim, volley and evolution response; 1/5/13 vessel progression; success/failure, all required audio, mute/cleanup, foreground hierarchy and bounded effects. Regions are real battlefield objects. No silence exception; no aesthetic score or candidate self-approval.
